resources.string: Type or paste a web address. ListenLock downloads that one page once and reads its article, without menus or ads.
Browse Project Gutenberg, or another catalogue you add, and download free books. Only the book you tap is downloaded.
ListenLock downloads this page once, keeps only the article and reads it like a book. Nothing about you is sent.
ListenLock will download the page from %1$s once and read its article.
Another download is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
That is not a web address. Check it and try again.
Could not reach the site. Check your internet connection and try again.
The site said no (error %1$d). The page may need a log-in, or it may be gone.
That is too large to download.
There is no article on that page to read. Open the article itself, not the site\'s home page.
That address is not a book catalogue (OPDS).
Could not save it on this phone. Free some space and try again.
A book downloads only when you tap Download, straight from the catalogue\'s own website. No account, and nothing about you is sent.
That catalogue is already in the list.
The list is full. Remove a catalogue first.
Could not save the list. Try again.
